# RVA SaaS Step 12 Core Platform Foundation

Production-oriented foundation aligned to the Source Value Assurance CTO baseline. This package implements the first executable shared-foundation slice: tenant identity/context, database tenant isolation, append-only audit/evidence primitives, API request context, CI validation and engineering traceability.

It does not claim the complete RVA SaaS, domain engines, connectors, case workflow, controlled external actions or production certification.
